correctness.rationale: For n=2,3,4,5 the directed-forest face criterion (at most one incoming arc per vertex and no directed cycles) was reconstructed independently. Flag orbits in sd Delta_n were canonicalized under all n! label permutations; their signed whole-flag cellular boundaries have d²=0. Independent exact integer Smith forms gave quotient cell counts [1], [3,3], [8,22,16], [19,121,226,125], boundary ranks [], [2], [7,15], [18,103,123], and integral Betti [1], [1,1], [1,0,1], [1,0,0,2]. Every nonzero Smith invariant was a unit. Complete-source shellability establishes simply connected labeled complexes for n>=4, and S_n is generated by transpositions each fixing an arc barycenter disjoint from the swapped labels; Armstrong gives quotient pi_1=1. Hurewicz and integral Whitehead give S² and S³ vee S³. All finite domains are exhausted; no n>=6 inference.
residual_risks: Depends on the standard Armstrong orbit-space theorem and complete-source shellability; not a claim about Borel equivariant quotients.

value.rationale: The full label-symmetry orbit space is a natural new object, not a mere relabeling of labeled forest homology. Exhaustive exact integral homotopy types through first two-sphere branching at n=5 give an independently useful finite cutoff and a test case for nonfree group actions, with no invented infinite-family extension.
